scope: General radar laboratory and environmental observation; metadata audit is not data validation

resources.name: Maqu calibration plates
resources.local_status: original complex frequency data and target geometry records acquired
resources.observable: complex S parameters and static range response
resources.geometry: rectangle dimensions, nominal distance and in-plane orientation; exact tilt/phase center incomplete
resources.model_family: scalar physical-optics area integral; finite conductivity/polarization not yet implemented
resources.license_status: local source manifest records CC BY 4.0
resources.next_evidence: cross-session delay/geometry issue remains; do not fit it away on evaluation records

resources.name: Maqu meadow angular backscatter
resources.local_status: angular sigma0 tables acquired; full raw meadow time series not yet acquired
resources.geometry: footprint and incidence intervals, no simultaneous complete 3D grass/soil model
resources.model_family: measured-coverage empirical surface coefficient; roughness and vegetation models require additional input
resources.license_status: local source manifest records CC BY 4.0
resources.next_evidence: calibration/validation split by measurement date; forbid extrapolation beyond frequency/incidence coverage

resources.name: IPIX Dartmouth
resources.observable: range-gated slow-time I/Q and Doppler statistics
resources.geometry: observation geometry and some sea-state metadata, no synchronized wave surface
resources.model_family: correlated complex field and non-Gaussian texture; existing model remains separate from geometry solver
resources.license_status: research terms and attribution; inspect official download terms
resources.next_evidence: stationarity, amplitude tails, range/time correlation and spectrum across separate records

resources.name: ARM KAZR spectra
resources.local_status: official instrument/product documentation located; raw files not acquired
resources.observable: Doppler spectra and radar moments; choose spectra product rather than moment-only product
resources.geometry: height gates with atmospheric auxiliary observations; not exact droplet positions
resources.model_family: volume-scatterer velocity distributions; candidate only, not implemented
resources.dynamic_rd_ground_truth: product-dependent; verify actual spectrum axes and calibration
resources.license_status: access/account and product terms require verification before acquisition
resources.next_evidence: inspect a bounded spectra file and co-located ancillary data; do not equate moments with full spectra

resources.name: SnowSAR snow-covered terrain
resources.local_status: primary data-description paper inspected; files not acquired
resources.observable: X/Ku-band polarimetric backscatter and supporting snow/terrain measurements
resources.geometry: georeferenced products and field measurements; not assumed exact electromagnetic mesh
resources.license_status: paper CC BY 4.0; data-product license must be checked separately
resources.next_evidence: secondary priority: use scattering strengths only, no SAR reconstruction added to this RD platform

resources.name: RADIATE
resources.local_status: primary paper inspected; files not acquired
resources.observable: automotive radar scenes in sun, rain, fog and snow with auxiliary sensors
resources.geometry: scene annotations/sensors do not provide complete material and scattering truth
resources.model_family: background scene statistics; candidate only, not a calibrated material model
resources.dynamic_rd_ground_truth: not established from inspected metadata; do not advertise as raw ADC/RD
resources.license_status: dataset terms and signal representation require verification
resources.next_evidence: lower priority until calibrated radar representation and access requirements are confirmed

resources.name: ACE MRR-2 precipitation spectral profiles
resources.local_status: three bounded NetCDF raw spectral files and source README/header/event list acquired and checksummed on 2026-10-15
resources.observable: real spectral signal power [record,height,native Doppler bin], quality fields and velocity-bin spacing
resources.geometry: height gates and vessel metadata; no independent droplet geometry or full wind field
resources.model_family: candidate precipitation volume model; adapter implemented, forward-model validation not yet implemented
resources.dynamic_rd_ground_truth: range/height-resolved power spectra, NOT complex ADC; signed velocity origin not yet verified
resources.license_status: CC BY 4.0 confirmed by source record and downloaded README
resources.next_evidence: join precipitation intervals, verify velocity convention and transfer function; keep unclassified dates and missing data explicit
